name: Marriage Troubles
overview: Scripture teaches that marriage is a sacred union ordained by God, where two become one flesh and should not be separated by human decision. Trusting in the Lord rather than relying on human understanding is essential to navigate difficulties in marriage. Love, which covers sins, counters strife and fosters joy in the relationship. While marriage is a blessing and a portion to be enjoyed, God’s design also sets clear boundaries against divorce except in cases of fornication, emphasizing faithfulness and commitment.
